problems.problem_title: EUV lithography process consulting — US expert in Singapore, CN fab client
problems.problem_description: China-based foundry (advanced fab) requests EUV lithography process knowledge transfer from a Singapore-based US national consultant currently at Intel Singapore. The consulting scope covers EUV resist process, stochastic defect reduction, and single-pass EUV patterning for sub-14nm nodes. Dual-jurisdiction conflict: US_EAR (BLOCK—controlled tech to CN) vs SG_SGCOA (requires independent domestic strategic goods REVIEW). Requires HITL escalation due to authority process conflict.
problems.business_impact: Strategic node advancement to sub-14nm for CN foundry

blocking_reasons: EAR_CONTROLLED_TECH_CN_DESTINATION
compliance_requirements.conflict_detail: US_EAR §730.1 BLOCK (CCL EAR99→3A001, CN destination) vs SG_SGCOA requires domestic REVIEW before export decision
compliance_requirements.gap_reference: GAP-D1: US national (Intel Singapore), based in SG, CN fab client. EUV litho sub-14nm CCL 3A001. US_EAR BLOCK vs SG_SGCOA REVIEW → HITL.

problems.problem_title: 3nm GAA process knowledge transfer — US expert in Singapore, CN partner
problems.problem_description: China SMIC partner (via Beijing R&D center) requests 3nm Gate-All-Around (GAA) process consulting from Singapore-based US national. Scope: GAA nanosheet formation, inner spacer engineering, and multi-threshold Vt tuning. Consultant is at Intel Singapore with direct 3nm research experience. US_EAR §730 declares BLOCK (3nm GAA = CCL EAR control, CN entity list); SG_SGCOA has independent dual-use review process with no automatic deference to US authority. Neither authority defers to the other → HITL escalation required.
problems.business_impact: Leading-edge node capability for CN fab competitive position
